title: SAFE validation: code and data for 'Does a Firm Profile Help an AI Agent Forecast Real Survey Answers? A Prospectively Specified Validation on the EC/ECB Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises for Polish Firms'
description: Code, the analysis plan frozen before confirmatory model evaluation with its development amendments, the frozen settings, aggregate reports and the paper sources of a validation of language-model forecasts of firms' answers to the EC/ECB Survey on the access to finance of enterprises (Poland). This paper uses data from the EC/ECB Survey on the access to finance of enterprises. The SAFE microdata are not included; every number of the paper's tables can be read from the aggregate reports (scripts/safe_paper_numbers.py); the README describes recomputation and a new replication. Code Apache-2.0; texts, plan, reports and paper CC BY 4.0.
